title: Decide whether to maintain, repair or replace one item

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: Repair decisions compare money, time, remaining useful service and actual suitability. Repair is not always cheaper, and an estimate of remaining life is uncertain rather than guaranteed.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Fictional ordinary shopping bag: one non-load-critical side seam is open; it is not used for heavy or safety-related loads. A competent repair service quotes 6 units and two 15-minute trips, estimates another year of ordinary use without guarantee. Replacement costs 10 with one 15-minute trip and similar estimated life. Budget 12; the owner has 20 discretionary travel minutes this week. No home sewing skill or willing unpaid helper is supplied. Deferral is possible because another intact bag is available.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Compare repair now, replacement now and defer with the existing bag. Include time and uncertain service life without assigning invisible labor.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A repair quote is 8, replacement 9, but repair requires a tool costing 12 that will not be reused. What belongs in the comparison?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Repair costs less money but 30 travel minutes exceed 20; replacement fits money/time; deferral also fits because another bag is available. A later repair might become feasible, but timing is unconfirmed. Partial: choose only the lowest price. Incorrect: assume free home repair or guaranteed life. The values of waste reduction and scarce time both remain legitimate.
criteria: All material costs and time are included
A defensible decision acknowledges its tradeoff

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: Include the actual total 20 if that tool is necessary, plus time and suitability. Do not omit acquisition cost to make repair appear cheaper; a borrowed tool would require a real agreement.
